name: 3D Grid Rasterization
definition: Voxelize a mesh and snap the resulting voxel centers to a fixed-width, height, and depth 3D grid, returning a flat array of ABGR colors.
summary: 3D Grid Rasterization converts triangle meshes into binary occupancy grids by projecting them onto three orthogonal planes using hardware rasterization, offering speed over conservative voxelization by discarding occluded fragments.
